title: Supplementary Materials for AI Contribution Governance Rules in Open Source Software: Effects on Information Visibility and Maintainer Comment Patterns
description: Supplementary materials for an empirical study of AI contribution governance rules in open source software. The archive includes rule-event evidence, adoption-date traces, matched control-event construction, an item-level analysis sample with raw text excluded, result tables, coding definitions, and reproduction code for the main event-window estimates.
